title: Inspect selected-history consent before and after acceptance
description: A developer inspects the recipient's invitation and accepted projections in the shipped Conversations component. The existing lab scenario derives these views through shared conversation reducers. Timeline seeking is explicitly a presentation harness, not a delivered accept command, authenticated recipient grant or end-to-end encryption proof. Its command callbacks remain inert; the live privacy/service assertions remain separate and unchanged.

steps.description: Freeze browser playback only. Shared reducers derive the existing selected-history views; no authenticated account, live command, service clock or stored grants are replaced.
steps.acknowledgement: Explicit test control; not a player action or hosted-service certification.

verifications: Before consent, only the selected message identifier is disclosed; the earlier private contents and authorized message list are absent.
